configure_nerfdet_model: configure a NeRF-DET model with ResNet-101 backbone, FPN neck, and voxel-based 3D detection head for ScanNet
configure_training_pipeline: configure the training pipeline with AdamW optimizer, step learning rate policy, and 12 total epochs
configure_data_loading: configure ScanNet multi-view dataset loading with image, depth, and ray-based NeRF sampling modalities
configure_test_pipeline: configure the test pipeline with 51 multi-view images, NMS threshold of 0.25, and score threshold of 0.01
configure_input_modality: configure input modalities to use images, depth maps, and ray directions while disabling lidar input
